entries.subject: DAMIT 5480: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-5480.txt. Model 5480, version 2019-10-23, pole (136°, -56°), period 8.0117 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: The retained calibration uses 40.828 ±0.247 km. effective body diameter

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: The display scale "20.414 km (size-calibrated model)" (masiero-2014-neowise) implies a diameter of 40.828 km, outside the added NEOWISE V2.0 neowise_mainbelt.csv record 400 (Masiero et al. 2014) diameter 42.406 ± 0.652 km (NEOWISE, NEATM). Both are shown; the display scale is not changed.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.
